features.name: Spellcasting
features.desc: You cast spells from the Ranger spell list using Wisdom (half caster, prepared spells). No cantrips.

features.name: Favored Enemy
features.desc: You always have Hunter's Mark prepared and can cast it without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus (per Long Rest).

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.desc: You can use the mastery properties of 2 kinds of weapons you're proficient with (you can change them after a rest).

features.name: Deft Explorer
features.desc: You gain Expertise (double Proficiency Bonus) in one skill you're proficient in, and you learn a language.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.desc: You choose a Fighting Style (Archery, Defense, Dueling, Two-Weapon Fighting, etc.).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.desc: You make two attacks when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Roving
features.desc: Speed +10 feet; you gain a Climb Speed and a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

features.name: Expertise
features.desc: You double your Proficiency Bonus for two more chosen skills you're proficient in.

features.name: Tireless
features.desc: As an action, you gain Temporary Hit Points (1d8 + Wisdom modifier) a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus (per Long Rest); when you finish a Short Rest, your Exhaustion level decreases.

features.name: Relentless Hunter
features.desc: Taking damage can't break your Concentration on Hunter's Mark. The target marked by it has Disadvantage on saving throws against your Ranger spells.

features.name: Nature's Veil
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you become Invisible until the end of your next turn; a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus (per Long Rest).

features.name: Precise Hunter
features.desc: You have Advantage on attack rolls against the target marked by your Hunter's Mark.

features.name: Primal Awareness
features.desc: You gain Blindsight with a range of 30 feet.

features.name: Foe Slayer
features.desc: Your Hunter's Mark die becomes a d10; once per turn, you can add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of an attack against the marked target.
